arabic text: bhai se dam e subh bichar jayegi zainab\nay raat na dhalna ke ujar jayegi zainab
english translation text: At dawn, Zainab will be separated from her brother.\nO night, do not end, for Zainab's home will be destroyed.

arabic text:
sone de sakina ko ke phir so na sakegi
rona bhi jo chahegi to phir ro na sakegi
asghar se mulakaat to phir ho na sakegi
ay raat na dhalna....
english translation text:
Let Sakina sleep, for afterward she may never sleep again.
Even if she wishes to weep, she may not be allowed to weep.
She will never again meet Asghar.
O night, do not end...

arabic text:
ghabraye huye laal hai sehmi hui mayein
jee bhar ke mai de lon ali akbar ko duayein
lena hai abhi aun o mohamad ki balayein
ay raat na dhalna....
english translation text:
The children are frightened, and the mothers are trembling.
Let me offer Ali Akbar prayers to my heart's content.
I must still ward away calamity from Aun and Muhammad.
O night, do not end...

arabic text:
ae raat bikhar ja tere bas may ho jahan tak
mit jayenge kal aal e payamber ke nishan tak
baaqi hai yeh manzar ali akbar ki azan tak
ay raat na dhalna....
english translation text:
O night, scatter yourself for as long as it lies within your power.
Tomorrow, every trace of the Prophet's family will be erased.
Only the scene of Ali Akbar's adhan still remains.
O night, do not end...

arabic text: har chund ke bachon ki abhi pyas hai baaqi\nkuch aankh may hasrat hai to kuch aas hai baaqi
english translation text: Although the children's thirst still remains,\nsome longing remains in their eyes, and some hope still survives.

arabic text: lekin mera bhai mera abbas hai baaqi\nay raat na dhalna....
english translation text: But my brother—my Abbas—still remains.\nO night, do not end...

arabic text:
baaqi hai abhi aal e muhamad ka safeena
beti ke sulane ko hai shabbir ka seena
jhoola ali asghar ka jhulaati hai sakina
ay raat na dhalna....
english translation text:
The ark of Muhammad's family still remains;
Shabbir's chest still puts his daughter to sleep,
and Sakina still rocks Ali Asghar's cradle.
O night, do not end...

arabic text:
kal kaun sunega ye meri aah o buka bhi
hoga tahe khanjar mere bhai ka gala bhi
khema to kuja sar pe na hogi ye rida bhi
ay raat na dhalna....
english translation text:
Tomorrow, who will hear my sighs and lament?
My brother's throat will lie beneath the dagger,
and no veil will remain upon my head—let alone upon the tent.
O night, do not end...

arabic text:
ae raat ghadi bhar ko tu rehne de sakoon may
ghir jayenge nasir mere aada ki safon may
yeh chand se chehre to naha jayenge khoon may
ay raat na dhalna....
english translation text:
O night, leave me in peace for just a little while.
My supporters will be surrounded by the enemy's ranks;
these moonlike faces will be bathed in blood.
O night, do not end...
